items.title: Elf Icing a Gingerbread Roof
items.alt: Black-curled cartoon elf in a green dress piping white icing onto a gingerbread house resting on a wrapped gift.
items.description: The piping bag meets the snowy edge of a candy-covered roof. A scalloped green dress, gold bow belt and red curled shoes frame the small baker beside a green Christmas parcel.

items.title: Elf Reading a Christmas Letter
items.alt: Smiling brown-haired cartoon elf seated on two Christmas gifts and holding an unfolded cream letter.
items.description: The elf reads a large blank letter with both hands while sitting above a green star-patterned parcel. Red lace-up curled boots hang over the gifts beneath a green tunic and cream sleeves.

items.title: Elf Stamping a Star Gift Tag
items.alt: Dark-haired cartoon elf in green overalls pressing a wooden stamp onto a large star-decorated gift tag.
items.description: A cream tag and red-and-white tie rest on the little wooden work surface. The elf leans over the stamp in green short overalls, with a red-sleeved shirt and striped stockings.

items.title: Elf Weighing a Christmas Parcel
items.alt: Auburn-haired cartoon elf in a green coat holding a small brass balance with a wrapped gift and gold weights.
items.description: The elf steadies the top of a hanging balance while pointing toward its ribboned parcel. A red folded cap and cream-trimmed green coat distinguish the upright figure.

items.title: Elf with an Open Christmas Music Box
items.alt: Blond-curled cartoon elf kneeling beside an open green music box containing a miniature tree and rocking horse.
items.description: A Christmas tree, gold stars and a little white rocking horse fill the red-lined box. The elf leans forward with one hand at its inner edge, dressed in a cream-trimmed green coat and brown curled shoes.

items.title: Elf Knitting a Striped Scarf
items.alt: Braided cartoon elf in a green dress sitting on a Christmas gift and knitting a long red-and-cream scarf.
items.description: Broad red and cream stripes lead from the elf's wooden needles to a fringed scarf end. Two dark braids, a red-banded green cap and buckled brown boots give the seated figure its own silhouette.
